title: GTD Deliberation rollout
approved_direction: Add risk-triggered deliberation with mandatory current-date freshness search before consequential planning.

epics.title: Deliberation contract
epics.outcome: Agents can challenge and reframe messy requests using current evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Activation rules distinguish high-risk framing from direct low-risk work.
Freshness search is recorded as inspectable evidence.

tasks.done_when: Problem Model schema requires freshness context.

epics.title: Direction to execution handoff
epics.outcome: Approved direction becomes bounded backlog work without silently reintroducing rejected scope.
acceptance_criteria: Backlog items contain acceptance criteria and evidence requirements.

tasks.done_when: Planning boundary reference exists and tests cover approval.

decision_log.decision: Use risk-triggered deliberation instead of mandatory deep thought for every task.
decision_log.reason: Preserves fast execution when framing risk is low.

risks: Deliberation could become verbose if sufficiency rules are ignored.
Freshness search can leak private context if search boundaries are not enforced.
next_action: Run deterministic tests and behavioral evals for the deliberation layer.
